name: Gerard Nasser
blurb: Bioinformatics PhD researcher at UNC Charlotte working where computational biology meets public health — building Hi-C metagenomic methods that link antimicrobial-resistance genes to their bacterial and plasmid hosts in built and wastewater environments.
summary: I develop Hi-C metagenomic methods that link antimicrobial-resistance genes to their bacterial and plasmid hosts in built and wastewater environments.
